macros.name: prismaflowarrow
macros.doc: Manually connects two nodes with an arrow. - `<source>`: The ID of the source node. - `<destination>`: The ID of the destination node.

macros.name: prismalabel
macros.doc: Adds a vertical label to the left of the diagram. - `<size>`: Size of the label box, typically `1.3*\mh`. - `<position>`: Position relative to a node.
